extracted.name: Pinakbet
extracted.description: Pinakbet is a vegetable-based dish from the Philippines with pork and prawns that makes a flavor-packed, delicious, and filling one-pot meal.
ingredient_lines: 0.25 pound zucchini, seeded and cut into bite-size pieces
0.25 pound eggplant, cut into bite-size pieces
1 small bitter melon, cut into bite-size pieces
instruction_lines: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat; stir in onion and garlic and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add pork; cook and stir until browned, 5 to 7 minutes.
Add prawns; cook and stir until they turn pink, about 5 minutes.
Stir in tomato; season with salt and pepper, cover and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in zucchini, okra, green beans, eggplant, and bitter melon; cover and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
